headline: Phillies rout Cardinals 12-3, win streak reaches eight
recap: The Phillies routed the Cardinals 12-3 on Saturday at Citizens Bank Park, breaking the game open early with three runs in the first inning, four more in the third and four more in the sixth. Andrew Painter allowed one run over seven innings with eight strikeouts and no walks to pick up the win and improve to 3-8. Bryce Harper went 1-for-4 with a three-run homer, his 26th of the season, and Kyle Schwarber added a two-run homer, his 38th, in a 2-for-3 night with a walk. Edmundo Sosa (2-for-4, double, two RBIs) and Bryan De La Cruz (1-for-4, two RBIs) also drove in runs, while Alec Bohm and J.T. Realmuto each had two hits.
The win was Philadelphia's eighth in a row. The Phillies are 72-58, in second place in the NL East, three games behind the first-place Atlanta Braves. St. Louis fell to 66-65.

Philadelphia and St. Louis close out their series Sunday at Citizens Bank Park, with first pitch at 1:35 PM ET. Cristopher Sanchez (16-4, 2.51 ERA) starts for the Phillies opposite Kyle Leahy for the Cardinals. Philadelphia is a -217 moneyline favorite, with St. Louis at +201.
